notes: me'az is read as a rule 30 fusion carrying even from; the competing reading would give from to the preposition alone and mark az unrepresented, but no English word here writes az's own lexeme.

The even is not the waw's: rule 16's second limit gives a waw the bare even only where the conjunction stands immediately before the limit preposition, and this waw stands before ad, so the whole-expression reading governs and that waw is unrepresented for want of a written connective.

save that is marked added and the deictic zeh unrepresented, on rule 55's count of the clause's conjunctions against the ASV's subordinators; the competing reading would hand save that to zeh as the word written where it stands.
